clarifications.preconfirmatory_calibration: Allowed only when defined by the frozen post-lock autonomous study design before confirmatory outcomes are observed. Calibration data must be disjoint from confirmatory data and must not be reported as confirmatory evidence.
clarifications.controlled_challenge: Allowed only when fault/challenge operators, selection rules, metrics, and analysis are frozen before challenge outcomes are observed. It must not be adapted after observing confirmatory outcomes to improve results.
clarifications.scientific_rerun_for_better_outcome: Remains prohibited. A completed confirmatory study must never be repeated, extended, filtered, or replaced merely because its effect size, confidence interval, or p-value is disappointing.
